paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.06% on average, with DAX strongest (+0.83%) and Dow Jones weakest (-1.23%). Brent crude changed -5.95% to 109.77. Gold changed +0.52% to 4,028.8. Bitcoin changed +0.22% to 80,200.5234. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.988%, a relative move of +0.71%. Among the firms tracked, Equinor (+5.17%) and Newmont (-4.59%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Bon Secours nears $6bn takeover of Bain-backed Surgery Partners (FT Markets). US hospital chain is the latest not-for-profit healthcare provider to seek a large deal Deals and capital markets: Marc Lore’s Wonder bets on Texas, automation and user-built restaurants as it mulls IPO (CNBC). Wonder is leaning into automation and user-built restaurants as founder Marc Lore prepares the startup for a potential IPO. Geopolitics and trade: Singapore to store Saudi oil in underground caverns (FT World). Agreement with Saudi Aramco aims to secure energy supplies for south-east Asia amid Middle East war disruption Geopolitics and trade: The right’s obsession with ‘civil war’ in Britain (FT World). Many of those stoking fears of bloody unrest don’t actually live in the country Also ranking highly: Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises: lending conditions tightened (ECB).
